title: Accelerating Nonlinear MPC by Behavior Cloning with Separated Timescales: Application to Nuclear Reactor Load-Following
abstract: arXiv:2610.38496v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Behavior Cloning (BC) of expert controllers for multiscale dynamical systems is challenging: state variables evolving at widely separated timescales induce highly nonlinear couplings that a shared latent space may fail to adequately represent, degrading closed-loop generalization. We propose Structured Representation Learning for Behavior Cloning (SRLBC), an architecture designed to leverage the physical knowledge of multiscale systems in which slow state variables, fast (stiff) state variables, and predictable exogenous inputs evolve at different timescales. On 500 long-horizon roll-outs of a pressurized water reactor (PWR) load-following benchmark -a high-dimensional, stiff industrial system with challenging safety constraints -and across 20 training seeds, separated embeddings systematically outperform shared embedding baselines on cumulative cost, imitation accuracy and constraint satisfaction. translated_title: 基于分离时间尺度行为克隆的加速非线性MPC：在核反应堆负荷跟踪中的应用
translated_abstract: 对多尺度动态系统的专家控制器进行行为克隆（BC）具有挑战性：以相差悬殊的时间尺度演化的状态变量会产生高度非线性的耦合，而共享潜空间可能无法充分表示这些耦合，从而降低闭环泛化性能。我们提出了结构化表示学习行为克隆（SRLBC），这是一种旨在利用多尺度系统物理知识的架构，其中慢状态变量、快（刚性）状态变量以及可预测的外生输入以不同的时间尺度演化。在压水堆（PWR）负荷跟踪基准测试——一个具有严格安全约束的高维刚性工业系统——的500次长时程推演中，以及在20个训练种子上，分离嵌入方法在累积成本、模仿精度和约束满足方面系统性地优于共享嵌入基线。由此得到的独立策略近似……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种利用多尺度系统物理知识的结构化表示学习行为克隆架构SRLBC，通过为慢变量、快变量和外生输入分离嵌入表示，在压水堆负荷跟踪基准上系统性地优于共享嵌入基线，从而加速非线性MPC。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SRLBC, a structured representation learning behavior cloning architecture that leverages multiscale physics by separating embeddings of slow, fast (stiff), and exogenous variables, systematically outperforming shared-embedding baselines and accelerating nonlinear MPC on a pressurized water reactor load-following benchmark.
